style: Photorealistic editorial documentary photograph, full-frame camera, natural light, restrained cinematic colour grade with deep navy-blue shadows, warm amber highlights and desaturated steel greys, subtle fine film grain. Accurate real-world scale, perspective and industrial detail. Any shipping containers are plain and weathered (rust red, slate blue, grey, off-white) with no lettering, logos or numbers. No text, no signage, no watermarks, no brand names, no company liveries, no faces looking at the camera.

images.alt: Loaded container ship entering a commercial port at dusk
images.purpose: Full-screen cinematic opener; lower-left kept empty for headline
images.prompt: A large modern container ship, fully loaded with stacked containers, gliding into a commercial port at blue-hour dusk, seen from a low elevated angle across calm dark water. The ship occupies the right two-thirds of the frame; distant ship-to-shore gantry cranes with small warm lights line the horizon. The lower-left third of the frame is calm dark water and soft sky, intentionally empty for a headline. Quiet, monumental, cinematic.
